subject: SIG: request for full external vendor roster and subprocessor details
messages:
From: Alice Gomez <alice.gomez@acmepayments.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2026 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: SIG vendor roster — additional subprocessor fields needed

Jordan —

Thanks for the quick work on the SIG so far. I opened the spreadsheet you uploaded but there are a few additional columns our compliance team requires to complete section A.3 (Subprocessors). Can you provide a single consolidated roster (CSV preferred) that includes, for each vendor:
- Vendor legal name and DBA (if different)
- Service / product used at Redwood
- Purpose / data processing purpose
- Types of data processed (e.g., auth tokens, PII, telemetry, billing metadata)
- Whether the vendor stores or transmits customer content
- Country/region of processing (regions, and primary data centers if possible)
- Contract link or PO reference
- Current SOC 2 / ISO status (and most recent report date)
- Any sub‑subprocessors used by that vendor (if known)
- Internal owner at Redwood (name + email)

We have a deadline to sign off the SIG next Wednesday; would appreciate the roster by EOD Friday if possible. I attached a small SIG template that highlights the columns we need.

Also: should the roster include lower‑risk SaaS (e.g., marketing automation) or focus solely on vendors that touch customer data? Our procurement team can advise, but a single export that covers both is easiest for us to ingest.

Appreciate it — we can hop on a quick call if that speeds things up.

Thanks,
Alice Gomez
Information Security Manager
Acme Payments

Attachment: SIG_template.xlsx (columns example)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Gomez <alice.gomez@acmepayments.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG vendor roster — additional subprocessor fields needed

Hi Alice —

Thanks for the list of columns and the template — that's very clear. I copied Monica (ops) and Mina (security) so we can turn this around quickly.

Plan: Monica will pull the canonical vendor export from our procurement system and attach a CSV. Mina will add SOC 2 links and any clarifications around telemetry and data residency.

Two quick clarifications while we assemble:
1) Do you want us to include marketing/sales SaaS (Marketo, HubSpot) in the same CSV, or only systems that process customer content/auth data? We can include a column called "risk_category" so you can filter.
2) For vendors that use multiple regions (AWS, GCP), would a per‑vendor list of primary regions be sufficient, or do you need per‑service region detail?

We'll aim to deliver the CSV + supporting evidence (SOC 2 link, encryption attestation, contract links) by Friday EOD PT. If you need it earlier, let me know and we can prioritize the highest‑risk vendors first.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Hi Alice — attaching our canonical export as requested. This is the consolidated vendor roster pulled from our procurement and CMDB systems. Columns follow your template plus an internal "owner" column. A few notes inline below.

Attachment: redwood_subprocessors_2026-03-22.csv (CSV, 42 rows)

Quick highlights from the CSV (first pass):
- AWS (Amazon Web Services) — compute, storage, logs; processes encrypted customer content; primary regions us‑west‑2, eu‑west‑1; SOC 2 Type II (2025-11)
- Google Cloud Platform — analytics batch jobs (backups); primary region us‑central1; SOC 2 Type II (2025-08)
- Datadog — observability/metrics; retains aggregated telemetry; does not store raw customer content; SOC 2 Type II (2025-10)
- Sentry — error telemetry; stores anonymized traces; owned by Observability team (diego.fernandez@redwood.ai)
- Segment (Twilio) — customer event routing; pseudonymized by default; owner: product-analytics@redwood.ai
- Zendesk — customer support platform; stores inbound customer tickets; retention per contract; EU tenant for EU customers
- Intercom — product messaging & support chat; primarily ephemeral messages, some transcript storage
- G Suite (Google Workspace) — internal collaboration (no customer content unless shared by employees)
- Stripe Connect — billing & payments; stores billing metadata, PCI‑related systems redacted per contract

Notes:
- The CSV includes a "stores_customer_content" boolean column; for any "true" entries we included contract references where applicable.
- We included lower‑risk marketing and HR SaaS (e.g., HubSpot, Greenhouse) but marked them as "marketing/hr" in the risk_category column.
- We're still confirming sub‑subprocessors for a few smaller vendors (analytics vendors); should have that detail by EOD tomorrow.

If you want, Mina can attach SOC 2 evidence and a short writeup about our telemetry retention/aggregation approach.

Thanks,
Monica Patel

Monica —

Thanks for the CSV, that helps a lot. A couple of follow‑ups so our reviewers can close the loop:
1) Telemetry providers: you list Sentry and Datadog. Does any telemetry provider receive raw PII or unredacted customer content (e.g., request bodies, attachments)? If so, which vendors and for what retention period?
2) Support tools: for Zendesk and Intercom — are EU customers pinned to an EU tenant (you mentioned an EU tenant for Zendesk). Do support transcripts get exported to any downstream analytics or backups outside the EU?
3) SOC 2: can you provide a link to the latest SOC 2 Type II report (or SharePoint/Drive bucket) and the contact for the person who can sign a non‑disclosure so we can receive the report?

If you can answer 1–3 and send the SOC 2 link, we should be able to complete the SIG. If it's helpful, we can redact columns and accept a sealed SOC 2 through an NDA.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — if you prefer a short call, I'm free tomorrow at 10am PT.

Best,
Alice
Information Security Manager
Acme Payments

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Gomez <alice.gomez@acmepayments.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG vendor roster — initial export attached (SOC 2 + clarifications)

Hi Alice —

Thanks for the detailed questions — below are concrete answers and links. Happy to jump on a quick call but I think this will allow your reviewers to proceed.

1) Telemetry (Sentry, Datadog, etc.) - We do not forward raw customer attachments or unredacted PII to telemetry providers. Error telemetry (Sentry) collects stack traces and exception payloads; we have scrubbing middleware in place that removes authentication tokens and masks common PII patterns before events are sent. Retention for traces is 30 days by default; logs in Datadog are kept for 90 days (indexing policy varies by plan). We can provide a pseudonymization statement and sample scrubber rules under NDA.

2) Support tools (Zendesk, Intercom) - Zendesk: EU customer support traffic is routed to our EU tenant; transcripts are retained according to contract and are not exported outside the EU tenant by default. Intercom: transcripts are session‑based; for customers who opt in to transcript export we flag and record export actions; those exports are stored encrypted in our EU storage when associated with EU customers.

3) SOC 2 Type II report + evidence - Link to our sealed SOC 2 Type II 2025 report (NDA required): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-soc2 (request access, cc security@redwood.ai)
- Primary contact for SOC 2 delivery and NDA: security@redwood.ai (attn: Mina Haddad)
- Additional supporting evidence bundle attached (redwood_sig_supporting_evidence.zip) — contains encryption attestations, key rotation policy excerpt, and data retention matrix.

A few final notes:
- We included marketing/sales SaaS in the CSV but marked them as low risk; you can filter by risk_category.
- Sub‑subprocessor detail: for Segment/Twilio we have a separate mapping and will share the subprocessor list for those vendors under NDA by tomorrow EOD.

If you'd like, we can provide a short recorded walkthrough of the CSV and evidence pack or set up a 30‑minute call to answer any residual questions.

Regards,
Mina Haddad
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
